title: Maze generator
description: Generate a perfect maze with one path between any two cells—handy for games, puzzles, or print-and-play sheets.
difficultyHint: We generate several random mazes and keep one whose solution length fits the slider: low = shorter path from entrance to exit, high = longer path (more steps). Use the 'New maze' button to apply.
solutionSteps: Shortest path through this maze: {{steps}} steps. A straight route along the grid between entrance and exit cells would need at least {{minSteps}}.
entranceExitHint: Pick an edge and slide to set the opening along it (0 = start of that edge when read from the top-left). Use “New maze” to apply a new layout with these openings.
slotHint: Range 0–{{max}} (north/south: from the left, east/west: from the top).
sameEntranceExit: Entrance and exit cannot be the same cell. Change one position.
solutionShownAria: Solution path from entrance to exit is shown in red.
lookHint: Thickness values shape how wide walls and corridors are in the vector grid. Larger mazes stay readable if you raise corridor width a bit.
copyImageError: Could not copy the image (browser or permissions).
copyNotSupported: Your browser does not support copying images from the page.
